_meta.coverage_metric: side-effect admission, Context Capsule and Runtime Receipt integrity, executable Agent Architecture scoring, meta-abstraction promotion gating, and domain-adapter safety refusal
_meta.purpose: Prove that a procedure claimed as applied was actually admitted, exercised and closed on the exact runtime subject, rather than mentioned in a plan or scored from free-form dimension values.

runnable.hollow_mutations: raw private reasoning payloads, stale or expired capsules, procedures without a source anchor, missing must dispositions, a successful close carrying unresolved obligations, and side effects admitted before the declared checkpoint
covers: a Context Capsule binds procedure IDs, source anchors, expected observation, expiry and context digest
a Runtime Receipt binds exact subject, action, assertion, evidence and terminal disposition
material side effects are gated at declared checkpoints rather than after the fact
a close with an unresolved must obligation is refused rather than reported as success
schema-invalid input exits 64 while a semantic contradiction exits 2
runnable.expected: the positive receipt is admitted; ten planted capsule, disposition, anchor and close-gate defects are refused; two input-error shapes stay distinct from a semantic refusal

runnable.good_evidence: a fixture-factory architecture record whose five dimension scores are each derived from executed procedure atoms, with every positive signal bound to an assertion and no Vibe contradiction outstanding
runnable.hollow_mutations: free-form dimension values not derived from atomic evidence, non-idempotent high-risk writes, model-owned high-risk authority, score tampering, digest tampering, and unclosed Vibe contradictions
covers: the architecture score is recomputed from atomic evidence rather than trusted from supplied 0..5 values
detected non-idempotent high-risk writes or model-owned high-risk authority cap promotion eligibility
Vibe-Coding signals must be closed, not merely documented
the standalone checker and the meta-abstraction checker share one scoring implementation
positive, Vibe, contradiction, tampering and malformed-input controls exercise exits 0, 2 and 64
runnable.expected: one positive record admitted and one Vibe case closed; sixteen planted scoring, authority, idempotency and digest defects refused; two input-error shapes stay distinct

runnable.good_evidence: a fixture-factory meta-eval record carrying architecture, grounding, generalization and regression evidence sufficient for its declared level, with human promotion authority retained
runnable.hollow_mutations: safety violations, unresolved applicable must procedures, missing negative control, missing held-out transfer, incomplete counterfactual attribution, absent production feedback closure, capability widening, private-data egress, and self-declared promotion
covers: architecture, grounding, generalization, regression and overall meta scores are recomputed rather than trusted
a safety violation or unresolved applicable must caps the score below the promotion threshold
each missing evidence class caps promotion at its own level rather than being averaged away
L0-L5 promotion requires both score thresholds and level-specific evidence counts
no promotion claim can be self-granted; human admission authority is retained
runnable.expected: one positive record admitted; twenty-eight planted safety, evidence-class, scoring and authority defects refused; two input-error shapes stay distinct

runnable.good_evidence: the committed e-commerce dispute adapter running its domain cases to completion under the runtime's admission gates
covers: the e-commerce dispute case is an executable domain adapter, not universal law in the core Skill
an adapter that performs an unsafe high-risk action is refused rather than scored
domain evidence stays in modules/ and does not migrate into the procedural core
absent or malformed adapter input stays distinct from a domain refusal
runnable.expected: the committed adapter is admitted and the unsafe adapter is refused; two input-error shapes stay distinct

runnable.good_evidence: a verdict from a judge of a different provider than the candidate, scoring only qualities deterministic assertions cannot decide, with the deterministic result travelling inside the verdict so the non-override rule is checkable
runnable.hollow_mutations: a deterministic failure converted to PASS, an unnamed deterministic failure, failed gates listed without a failure, an unavailable judge scoring anyway, an available judge producing no outcome, scores outside the rubric scale, an outcome contradicting its own threshold, a rubric-injection anchor passing, a known-bad anchor passing, a known-good anchor failing, a verdict citing no evidence, and a judge sharing session context with the candidate
covers: a semantic judge may lower a score but never converts a deterministic failure into PASS
a deterministic failure must name the gates it failed, or the override rule cannot be checked against it later
an unavailable judge degrades to NOT_EXERCISED rather than to silent success
calibration anchors behave as expected: injection and known-bad refused, known-good admitted
a judge sharing mutable session context with the evaluated model is unspellable rather than discouraged
repeat disagreement is reported rather than averaged away
runnable.expected: a lowered score and an unavailable judge are admitted; twelve planted override, anchor, scale and availability defects are refused; a shared-session judge is schema-invalid

established: deterministic refusal of the planted defect classes named above, on committed fixtures and factory-constructed records
